context: A boss reviews next-year strategy with his manager
purpose: Teach: ビジョン/不況/意向/階層/儲け/結成/継承/有力

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来年度の企業ビジョンについて、君の意見を聞きたい。
lines.en: I want to hear your opinion on next year's corporate vision.
lines.style: Authoritative tone with measured executive cadence and gravitas.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。長引く不況の影響で、市場全体がかなり冷え込んでおります。
lines.en: Yes. Due to the prolonged recession, the entire market has cooled considerably.
lines.style: Polite keigo delivered with careful business deference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うむ。本社の意向もあってな、組織階層を見直したいと考えている。
lines.en: Hmm. Given headquarters' intentions, I'm thinking of revising the organizational hierarchy.
lines.style: Decisive thinking-aloud with executive gravitas and weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: なるほど。ただ、現状でしっかり儲けが出ている部門は維持すべきかと存じます。
lines.en: I see. However, departments currently turning a solid profit should be maintained.
lines.style: Cautious counterpoint delivered with respectful hedging and care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: もちろんだ。それと、新規事業を推進するチームの結成も急ぎたい。
lines.en: Of course. Also, I want to hurry the formation of a team to drive new ventures.
lines.style: Forward-looking command with brisk strategic urgency and clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 創業以来の理念の継承も踏まえますと、田中部長が有力な候補かと存じます。
lines.en: Considering the inheritance of our founding philosophy as well, I believe Director Tanaka would be a strong candidate.
lines.style: Deferential suggestion offered with humble certainty and tact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 彼か。確かに実績もある。明日、本人の意向も確認しておいてくれ。
lines.en: Him, huh. He certainly has a track record. Please confirm his intentions tomorrow.
lines.style: Approving directive with crisp closing instruction and authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。直ちに面談の場を設定いたします。
lines.en: Understood. I will arrange a meeting immediately.
lines.style: Formal acknowledgment with prompt subordinate efficiency and poise.
